response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_rate) as mean_per_day_rate, COUNT(*) as rating_count FROM rating_stats) SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.per_day_rate, rs.per_day_rate / os.mean_per_day_rate FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE os.rating_count = 5

assumptions.assumption: Per-day rental price is calculated as AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)—the average of each film's per-day rate within the rating—rather than AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration).

alternatives.interpretation: Per-day rental price is calculated as AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration), the ratio of the average rental rate to the average rental duration within each rating.
